T001.description: Extend the existing scenario fixture in `tests/consumer-fixtures/workflow-improvements/implementation-scope-cases.json` with stable scenario IDs, requirement IDs, valid-control references, one-mutation negative cases, and expected production outcomes for Feature 023; keep it as scenario input data and do not encode routing or guard decisions in the fixture.

T002.description: [P] [US1] Add controller definition tests in `tests/test_controller.py` for misplaced `cases.default`, malformed root/node/case/default containers, supported empty branches, and unknown, self, forward, cross-branch, and post-join-infeasible producer references; assert stable lowercase hyphenated `reason_code` values, exact node IDs, and root `location: workflow` or `steps` with an explicit null `step_id`, as required by `data-model.md` and `contracts/validation-boundaries.md`; exclude raw input values, rendered prompts, and host paths.

T003.description: [P] [US1] Add source inventory and graph tests in `tests/test_workflow_graph.py` and `tests/test_workflow_paths.py` proving every owned package is validated, valid earlier-producer references do not require pre-production outputs, and the deprecated Start Feature remains stop-only.

T004.description: [US1] Add catalog boundary tests in `tests/test_catalog.py` that attempt invalid source build, development snapshot, verification, and install/refresh from disposable inputs, assert rejection before package or consumer writes, and compare consumer before/after inventories.

T005.description: [US1] Extend `validate_workflow_definition()` and its graph/template helpers in `controllers/farmboy/scripts/python/controller.py` to validate malformed branch structures, reserve `default` as a sibling of `cases`, accept supported empty lists, and prove producer order and route feasibility with bounded prior-producer propagation; retain the existing `ValueError` failure contract and loop-condition/carrier rules.

T006.description: [US1] Project contextual definition diagnostics from `tools/validate_workflows.py` and validate source definitions before catalog packaging, release verification, development-snapshot approval, and delivery effects in `tools/catalog.py`; preserve existing ownership and installation checks.

T007.description: [P] [US2] Extend `tests/test_implement_switch_routing.py` with production-route cases for both preparation/source skips, empty cases, empty top-level defaults, unknown choices without a fallback, and zero execution of untaken branch children.

T008.description: [P] [US2] Extend `tests/test_workflow_paths.py` and `tests/test_controller.py` with runtime rendering cases proving earlier producer references pass definition validation before production, are resolved only when consumed, and reject missing, invalid, or stale prior-pass outputs before affected effects.

T009.description: [US2] Update selected-route traversal and runtime preflight in `controllers/farmboy/scripts/python/controller.py` to render switch expressions/applicable metadata, select through `select_switch_branch()`, and render selected children only at consumption; preserve `render_template(value, inputs, outputs)`, current-output validation, and existing successor/guard behavior.

T010.description: [US2] Update the rendering and selected-child boundaries in `controllers/farmboy/controller-protocol.md` and `workflows/README.md` so the manual-prompt route observes the same selected-only rendering and safe-stop behavior as native dispatch.

T011.description: [P] [US3] Add connected positive expectations in `tests/test_snapshot_validation.py` and scenario records in `tests/consumer-fixtures/workflow-improvements/implementation-scope-cases.json` for task resolution followed by marker-only tracking and for genuine reviewed source correction; assert historical scope/assessment/preimage digests remain unchanged while current evidence is rechecked.

T012.description: [P] [US3] Add attributable negative controls in `tests/test_implementation_progress.py` and `tests/test_controller.py` for forged, altered, missing, or unbound historical proof; stale current review; unauthorized task edits; missing or wrong-branch required outputs; no substantive progress; and each existing exhausted budget. Add otherwise-valid administrative-only, answer-only, marker-only, and fresh-child-session variants and assert none creates substantive resolution, reconstructs historical proof, or resets existing counters/budgets; retain same-child answer relay and independently reviewed genuine-progress controls. Each case must establish a valid control, mutate one guard, and assert the expected reason/action with no subsequent source dispatch.

T013.description: [US3] Extend `tests/test_phase_lifecycle.py` with regression assertions for applied roadmap-preimage readback: preserve receipt/effect identity and mutation count without invoking the writer again, and continue rejecting a separately changed non-roadmap artifact.

T014.description: [US3] Extend `tests/implementation_scope_snapshot.py` to execute the two connected positive traces using production rendering, branch selection, activation/history, task tracking, actual post-pass capture, and guarded progress/route helpers; use the existing exact `post-pass-capture` request fields `scope`, `trusted_request_reference`, `retained_scope_sha256`, `entry_history_sha256`, `task_tracking_successors`, `producer_pairs`, `eligibility_request`, `completion_branch`; record selected and prevented steps and counters without copying controller decisions into the harness. Assert successful traces produce zero undeclared workflow or phase dispatch, Git integration, real-roadmap verification, or feature/consumer acceptance effects.

T015.description: [US3] Extend `tests/implementation_scope_snapshot.py` to run each negative mutation from its valid control and capture the production blocker/action, zero later dispatch, unchanged retained records, and unchanged counters; cover assignment, unresolved gate, same-child answer relay, installation-drift stops, and the administrative-only, answer-only, marker-only, and fresh-child-session non-credit variants without fallback. Assert none reconstructs historical proof or resets budgets, and blocked traces produce zero undeclared workflow or phase dispatch, Git integration, real-roadmap verification, or feature/consumer acceptance effects.

T016.description: [US4] Extend `tests/test_snapshot_validation.py` with paired source/installed assertions for valid skips and empty/default routes, malformed definition rejection, producer timing, both positive connected traces, all FR-009 negative guards, and matching selected/prevented steps, blockers, current-evidence decisions, and counters. Include lifecycle receipt-readback parity and successful/blocked trace assertions for zero undeclared workflow or phase dispatch, Git integration, real-roadmap verification, or feature/consumer acceptance effects; the disposable lifecycle execution is added in T018.

T017.description: [US4] Add portable-observation contract tests in `tests/test_snapshot_validation.py` for component IDs/versions/raw digests, repository-relative coordinates, tested CLI/runtime, installed inventory, scenario and requirement IDs, execution mode, expected/observed results, effects/dispatch, valid control, and parity; reject absolute paths, personal identifiers, secrets, and raw transcripts.

T018.description: [US4] Extend the supported disposable development-snapshot setup in `tests/implementation_scope_snapshot.py` and `tests/test_snapshot_validation.py` to load the same scenario descriptions against source and installed controller modules and workflow bytes; include a disposable applied-roadmap receipt readback/reassessment through the installed production lifecycle module as well as source, without mutating Feature 023's real roadmap. Assert no second writer invocation and unchanged receipt identity, timestamp, digest, and mutation count, then reject a separately changed non-roadmap artifact; use the existing catalog installer and initialized-consumer prerequisites, and fail when any required integration prerequisite is missing instead of counting a skip as parity. Preserve commit `54b394e` as a regression baseline rather than reimplementing its fix.

T019.description: [US4] Extend the feature-local observation writer in `tests/implementation_scope_snapshot.py` to record actual provenance, expected/observed outcomes, effects, retained before/after hashes, counters, valid-control/mutation references, and source/installed parity; include lifecycle effect and receipt identity, timestamp/digest, mutation count, retained receipt/preimage, and non-roadmap current-hash rejection observations. Enforce `Repository-relative coordinates only, with no host paths, personal identifiers, secrets or raw transcripts.` Label deterministic Reviewer/Tasker outcomes as deterministic; they cannot establish native agent identity/settings, publication, stock compatibility, adoption or acceptance.

T020.description: [P] Document definition/runtime boundaries, diagnostic interpretation, selected-route input timing, safe next actions, and deterministic evidence limits in `docs/installation.md` and `tests/consumer-fixtures/README.md`.

T021.description: Run the focused source and disposable-consumer commands in `specs/023-workflow-branch-validation-controller-integration/quickstart.md`, record actual CLI/runtime and component/source digests in feature-local `specs/023-workflow-branch-validation-controller-integration/validation/`, and report any unavailable prerequisite or failed parity scenario without claiming broader compatibility or acceptance.
